highlights: One Vercel application with platform control and tenant workspaces
Removed the unintended Marktone internal CRM workspace
Tenant CRM remains a module inside each tenant workspace
Introduced a clean database foundation independent from the failed legacy implementation
Moved authentication and workspace snapshots to isolated v2 RPCs
Added lint, type checking, tests, and build validation
Provision a tenant with its owner, plan, modules, and domain in one transaction
Invite and activate tenant users without exposing an administrative Supabase key
Created Reef Skills Training Center as the first active tenant on the full plan
Added a tenant-scoped staff directory with eleven real initial profiles
Added the Academy course catalog with six Reef training programs
Added full-plan entitlements for all current modules and unlimited users and courses
Added staff profile editing and account activation from the Reef team page
Added role-aware tenant navigation and route protection
Rebuilt tenant CRM and work management on isolated v2 schemas
Added customers, pipeline stages, opportunities, activities, and role-scoped tasks
Enforced a next action and due date after every customer interaction
Added Reef daily operations dashboard and clearly marked sample workflow data
Replaced the traditional opportunity board with a lead-centric sales workflow
Added lead status, lead quality, source, campaign, and advertising attribution
Created the next follow-up task automatically after every open sales outcome
Added fast filters for awaiting payment, very interested, excellent, and unqualified leads
Handed paid leads directly to registration and admissions with an operational notification
Opened the complete sales follow-up flow directly from customer tasks in the calendar
Added simple calendar filters for customer follow-ups, interested, very interested, and awaiting payment
Reduced the lead-centric board to four responsive stages without horizontal scrolling
Added next-action date filters with today, seven-day, month, and custom-range options
Separated customer-reported payment from finance-verified payment
Enforced one active sales follow-up and mandatory next actions or closure reasons
Added a role-protected admissions queue with payment and document review
Added acceptance, student creation, and course-run enrollment workflows
Added operational batches with capacity, registration windows, delivery status, and seat availability
Added a session-by-session timetable with conflict validation and tenant-timezone handling
Prevented admissions from assigning or enrolling into closed, full, or unavailable batches
